result.title: AlignPre: Skill-Aligned Post-Training for Latent-Free Generative Precipitation Nowcasting
result.summary: Precipitation nowcasting requires accurate short-term predictions under rapidly evolving spatiotemporal dynamics. Generative diffusion models can produce detailed and competitive radar forecasts by modeling conditional distributions. However, most existing approaches rely on separately trained components, such as deterministic branches or latent compression modules. More fundamentally, distribution matching alone fails to explicitly optimize operational forecast skill. We propose AlignPre, a streamlined pixel-space nowcasting framework that bridges this gap via skill-aligned post-training (SAPT). AlignPre employs an end-to-end flow-matching forecaster with a hierarchical spatiotemporal architecture for distribution matching and direct radar-field synthesis, without latent compression. During post-training, SAPT exploits the analytic structure of forecast verification scores to construct a differentiable objective. By backpropagating gradients of this objective from radar fields to the generator, SAPT turns forecast verification into direct training feedback. Across three real-world benchmarks spanning different forecast horizons, AlignPre consistently surpasses state-of-the-art deterministic and generative baselines in forecast skill, demonstrating that aligning generative modeling with domain-specific verification provides an effective paradigm for meteorological forecasting.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 AlignPre，一个像素空间、无 latent 压缩的端到端 flow-matching 降水临近预报框架，并在后训练阶段用可微的预报检验评分梯度（SAPT）直接优化生成器。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「latent-free」仅指扩散建模跳过隐空间压缩，与 LVR 的推理 latent 不是同一概念；但把领域可验证评分转成可微训练反馈的做法，可能为 latent 推理轨迹的任务级监督与贡献分配提供借鉴，值得核查。
